mapper.select: SELECT global_open_paused, auto_global_paused, auto_liquidation, platform_net_threshold FROM risk_switch WHERE id = 1
SELECT symbol, net_threshold, manual_paused, auto_paused FROM risk_symbol ORDER BY symbol
SELECT manual_paused = 1 OR auto_paused = 1 FROM risk_symbol WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_switch SET global_open_paused = #{manual}, auto_global_paused = #{auto} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE risk_switch SET auto_global_paused = 1 WHERE id = 1 AND auto_global_paused = 0
UPDATE risk_switch SET auto_liquidation = #{enabled} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE risk_switch SET platform_net_threshold = #{threshold} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE risk_symbol SET manual_paused = #{manual}, auto_paused = #{auto} WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
UPDATE risk_symbol SET auto_paused = 1 WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND auto_paused = 0
UPDATE risk_symbol SET net_threshold = #{threshold} WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_event (kind, symbol, net_usd, threshold, operator_id) VALUES (#{kind}, #{symbol}, #{netUsd}, #{threshold}, #{operatorId})
